svg.text: OV2640 camera · microSD slot on board
• white flash LED GPIO4 — forced off
• BLE time sync with the sniffer
Divider must be taken BEFORE the Schottky diode, otherwise the supercap keeps the sense voltage high and power loss is detected late.
On power loss the firmware closes the SD card and goes to deep sleep while running from the supercap. Calibrate POWER_LOST_THRESHOLD on the real divider.
R ∥ diode limits the supercap inrush current at power-up; the diode (anode to the cap) lets the cap discharge into the 5 V node without loss on R.
Aiming firmware: Wi-Fi AP "ESP32CAM-Aiming", http://192.168.4.1 — flash it, aim the camera, then flash the recording firmware back.
Start the sniffer first; the camera syncs its clock over BLE once at start-up.
